request.reason: Independent review identified a production compatibility defect in the current narrow Rustup parser: Rustup default_host_tuple is optional, and a fully host-qualified selected toolchain carries its own exact host identity even when it differs from the configured default. Make this behavior explicit in the same bounded WI-1079 acceptance boundary. Keep short-channel resolution dependent on a validated configured host, exact directory selection, fail-closed malformed/conflicting/ambiguous cases, and no unique-prefix fallback. Preserve the existing exact-reuse and toolchain-byte-change regression goals; do not add general custom-toolchain resolution or alter gates.

changes.value: Rustup host selection treats default_host_tuple/default_host_triple as optional metadata. A selected toolchain name with a validated explicit host suffix resolves to that exact installed directory, independent of a different configured default host; a short channel name requires a validated default host and resolves only to the exact qualified directory. Missing host for a short channel, malformed/conflicting metadata, or non-exact resolution remains fail-closed; no unique-prefix fallback. Regression coverage verifies an explicit full host without a settings host, an explicit host differing from configured default, unchanged-identity reuse, and toolchain-byte changes forcing re-execution. This scope does not add general custom-toolchain resolution.

acceptanceCriteria: A new explicit versioned mode supports separate and combined lifecycle with shared strict semantics; v1 and v2 behavior remains unchanged and no synthetic stage commit is created.

Combined validation derives allowed operations from artifacts and Runtime normalization; binds Contract Summary events verification attempts reports Outcome and archive manifest; unchanged verification and all prior failed attempts remain byte identical with their original Runtime identity; extra source foreign Work Item unknown artifact and resealed tampering fail closed.

Validate H0 to H1 governance-only changes independently of M0 to actual B main advancement; bind original source PR and actual provider B H1 M1; M0 is ancestor of B and M1 is the proven exact clean merge result; conflicts or added merge content fail closed.

Explicit absent docs is valid only when Contract permits and parent head actual base and merged result have no Work Item page parity entry or active document reference; existing projections cannot be removed to claim absence and historical report or evidence references remain legal.

Preserve delegated provider identity freshness ambiguity checks same-common surviving control Retained Deleted predecessor verification and real human close; public CLI fixtures prove both WI1078 combined absent advanced-base and WI1076 separate projected routes and a successor closeout route.

Successor finish archive and documentation are separately committed after formal verification; later production finalization and human close remain later-stage evidence rather than finish prerequisites.

Rustup settings parsing accepts a validated default_host_tuple or its default_host_triple alias, rejects duplicate keys and simultaneous alias declarations, validates host values, preserves the full settings-byte digest, and keeps unknown keys, non-empty overrides, missing/symlinked settings or incomplete toolchain identity fail-closed.

A short Rustup toolchain name resolves only to an exact installed toolchain proven to match the validated host tuple; there is no unique-prefix fallback across hosts. Host/config/toolchain changes block reuse, while identical observed inputs permit exact reuse.

Regression tests in the composition parser cover tuple and triple alias acceptance; duplicate, alias-conflict and invalid-host rejection; unknown keys and non-empty overrides; missing/symlinked settings; short-name cross-host selection or ambiguity; full settings-byte hash changes; toolchain/config changes blocking reuse; and exact reuse for identical configuration.
previousContract.goal: Make the existing WI-1078 combined finish/archive history legally finalizable with strict artifact, semantic, provider, merge-result and documentation proof, and prove the successor own closeout route before archive.
previousContract.intent: Add an explicit versioned post-merge finalization mode for truthful separate or combined lifecycle commits and an advanced main base, preserving v1/v2 and immutable history.
